description: This file defines the RegexChannelNamespacePredicate class which implements IChannelNamespacePredicate interface. It provides functionality to filter stream namespaces using regular expressions, including constructing predicate patterns and matching namespace strings.

classes.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Implements IChannelNamespacePredicate to filter stream namespaces by regex pattern.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern used for stream namespace filtering, combining prefix with regex pattern.

methods.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex object with a provided pattern.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the provided namespace string matches the regex pattern.
